sources.snippet: Inference examples Transformers You can use gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b with the Transformers library. If you use Transformers' chat template, it will automatically apply the harmony response format. If you use model.generate directly, you need to apply the harmony format manually using the chat template or use our openai-harmony package.
